sections.text_helper: Section 8.10.9 "PWR I/O retention register (PWR_IORETR)" in chapter 8 (Power control (PWR)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 248.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x050
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register is protected against unprivileged access PRIV=1 in the PWR_PRIVCFGR
register.
Bits 31:17 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 16 JTAGIORETEN: IO retention enable for JTAG I/Os
0: I/O retention mode is disabled.
1: I/O retention mode is enabling for PA13, PA14, PA15, and PB4.
When entering Standby mode, the output is sampled, and apply to the output I/O during the
Standby power mode.
Bits 15:1 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 0 IORETEN: IO retention enable
0:I/O retention mode is disabled.
1:I/O retention mode is enabling for all I/Os except the I/O support the standby functionality
and PA13, PA14, PA15, and PB4.
When entering Standby mode, the output is sampled, and apply to the output I/O during the
Standby power mode.
Note: The I/O state is not retained if the DBG_STANDBY bit is set in DBGMCU_CR register.
